WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE powerstatus IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) as total
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.powerstatus, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as proportion
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.powerstatus, s3.cnt, s3.proportion, s3.proportion - s4.avg_proportion as diff
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.proportion > s4.avg_proportion
)
SELECT 
  SUM(cnt) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(proportion) as avg_of_proportions,
  AVG(diff) as avg_of_differences
FROM step5
